items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Single disclosure row on Base UI Collapsible: the same bullet and inverted open state as Accordion, panel height animated with yorha-collapse.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Compose Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsiblePanel. Closed panel is hidden=until-found (v4): find-in-page opens it; hiddenUntilFound={false} opts out.
